citation: Meek CL, et al. Expected values for gastrointestinal and pancreatic hormone concentrations in healthy volunteers in the fasting and postprandial state. Ann Clin Biochem 2021.
protocol: Overnight fast; Ensure Plus 237 mL (350 kcal: 50 g carbohydrate, 13 g protein, 11 g fat) or 75 g OGTT, crossover; samples 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240 min
population: n=28 healthy volunteers (12 M, 16 F), mean age 31.3 y, mean BMI 24.9
note: A full mixed-liquid-meal curve to 240 min with printed composition. The spread printed may be 2.5th-97.5th percentile limits, not SD: read the results before entering anything. Insulin and C-peptide at 0-240 min in a 20-person subset.
